query: What is the fee to replace a lost student identity card?

retrieved.section: 2. Reporting a lost or stolen card

context.text:
1. Scope
This procedure applies to every registered student who needs a replacement university identity card. The card is needed to enter campus buildings and examination halls and to borrow from the library.

3. Replacement charges
The following charges apply: - First loss or theft of the card: Rs 800. - Second or later loss during the same degree programme: Rs 1,200. - Damaged card that is handed in with the request: Rs 400. - Printing error made by the university: no charge. The charge is paid by bank challan before the request is processed, and it is not refunded if the old card is found later. [removed by retrieval rail]

context.text:
2. Reporting a lost or stolen card
A student who loses a card reports it to the Academic Office within two working days. The old card is blocked on the working day on which the report is received. A police report is needed only when the card was stolen. A card that is found after it has been blocked is handed in to the Academic Office and is not used again.

5. Collection
The student collects the new card in person and signs the issue register. A card that is not collected within 60 days is cancelled, and a fresh request with a new payment is then required.
